deployOrder: ORDER REVISED (council 2026-07-20): POOL FIRST. Both x402Core AND factory constructors staticcall <sink>.isInfraSink() and revert FeeSinkInterfaceMismatch if the pool is not a live infra-sink — so the pool (Heart) MUST land before them. Authoritative runbook: RUNBOOK_DEPLOY.md / RUNBOOK_CONSTELLATION.md §2.
1. pool     (CREATE3, EOA-keyed; authorizedSources=[factory,x402core] baked as PREDICTED addrs, read only at runtime) -> extcodehash gate == expected(pool)
2. x402core (CREATE3, EOA-keyed; ctor verifies pool live via isInfraSink brick-guard; heartSink surplus routes to pool) -> extcodehash gate
3. factory  (CREATE3, EOA-keyed; ctor verifies pool live via isInfraSink brick-guard; feeSink=pool) -> extcodehash gate
4. saltpool (CREATE3, EOA-keyed; factory=live factory) -> extcodehash gate
5. keeper refills saltpool with hookSalts (0x8C8, factory-keyed)
NOTE: extcodehash 'expected' values are recorded at fork-test time from the compiled runtime code.
